cohort: The study included 280 pregnant women, divided into a Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) group and a control group without RA.
finding: Pregnant women with Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) experienced a significantly higher incidence of spontaneous abortion, cesarean section, and low birth weight compared to pregnant women without RA.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in the RA group (24.3%) compared to the control group (10.7%, P=0.003), with RA increasing the probability of cesarean section by more than 2.2 times.
